verses.ar: فَٱجْتَازَا فِي أَمْفِيبُولِيسَ وَأَبُولُونِيَّةَ، وَأَتَيَا إِلَى تَسَالُونِيكِي، حَيْثُ كَانَ مَجْمَعُ ٱلْيَهُودِ.
verses.kjv: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
verses.web: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

verses.ar: فَدَخَلَ بُولُسُ إِلَيْهِمْ حَسَبَ عَادَتِهِ، وَكَانَ يُحَاجُّهُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ سُبُوتٍ مِنَ ٱلْكُتُبِ،
verses.kjv: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
verses.web: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

verses.ar: مُوَضِّحًا وَمُبَيِّنًا أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَنْبَغِي أَنَّ ٱلْمَسِيحَ يَتَأَلَّمُ وَيَقُومُ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ، وَأَنَّ: هَذَا هُوَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ يَسُوعُ ٱلَّذِي أَنَا أُنَادِي لَكُمْ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
verses.web: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

verses.ar: فَٱقْتَنَعَ قَوْمٌ مِنْهُمْ وَٱنْحَازُوا إِلَى بُولُسَ وَسِيلَا، وَمِنَ ٱلْيُونَانِيِّينَ ٱلْمُتَعَبِّدِينَ جُمْهُورٌ كَثِيرٌ، وَمِنَ ٱلنِّسَاءِ ٱلْمُتَقَدِّمَاتِ عَدَدٌ لَيْسَ بِقَلِيلٍ.
verses.kjv: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
verses.web: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

verses.ar: فَغَارَ ٱلْيَهُودُ غَيْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذُوا رِجَالًا أَشْرَارًا مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلسُّوقِ، وَتَجَمَّعُوا وَسَجَّسُوا ٱلْمَدِينَةَ، وَقَامُوا عَلَى بَيْتِ يَاسُونَ طَالِبِينَ أَنْ يُحْضِرُوهُمَا إِلَى ٱلشَّعْبِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.web: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا لَمْ يَجِدُوهُمَا، جَرُّوا يَاسُونَ وَأُنَاسًا مِنَ ٱلْإِخْوَةِ إِلَى حُكَّامِ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ صَارِخِينَ: «إِنَّ هَؤُلَاءِ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا ٱلْمَسْكُونَةَ حَضَرُوا إِلَى هَهُنَا أَيْضًا.
verses.kjv: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
verses.web: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

verses.ar: وَقَدْ قَبِلَهُمْ يَاسُونُ. وَهَؤُلَاءِ كُلُّهُمْ يَعْمَلُونَ ضِدَّ أَحْكَامِ قَيْصَرَ قَائِلِينَ: إِنَّهُ يُوجَدُ مَلِكٌ آخَرُ: يَسُوعُ!».
verses.kjv: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cæsar, saying that there is another king, [one] Jesus.
verses.web: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

verses.ar: فَأَزْعَجُوا ٱلْجَمْعَ وَحُكَّامَ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ إِذْ سَمِعُوا هَذَا.
verses.kjv: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
verses.web: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذُوا كَفَالَةً مِنْ يَاسُونَ وَمِنَ ٱلْبَاقِينَ، ثُمَّ أَطْلَقُوهُمْ.
verses.kjv: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
verses.web: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْإِخْوَةُ فَلِلْوَقْتِ أَرْسَلُوا بُولُسَ وَسِيلَا لَيْلًا إِلَى بِيرِيَّةَ. وَهُمَا لَمَّا وَصَلَا مَضَيَا إِلَى مَجْمَعِ ٱلْيَهُودِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming [thither] went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.web: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَشْرَفَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي تَسَالُونِيكِي، فَقَبِلُوا ٱلْكَلِمَةَ بِكُلِّ نَشَاطٍ فَاحِصِينَ ٱلْكُتُبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ: هَلْ هَذِهِ ٱلْأُمُورُ هَكَذَا؟
verses.kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.web: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

verses.ar: فَآمَنَ مِنْهُمْ كَثِيرُونَ، وَمِنَ ٱلنِّسَاءِ ٱلْيُونَانِيَّاتِ ٱلشَّرِيفَاتِ، وَمِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ عَدَدٌ لَيْسَ بِقَلِيلٍ.
verses.kjv: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
verses.web: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا عَلِمَ ٱلْيَهُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنْ تَسَالُونِيكِي أَنَّهُ فِي بِيرِيَّةَ أَيْضًا نَادَى بُولُسُ بِكَلِمَةِ ٱللهِ، جَاءُوا يُهَيِّجُونَ ٱلْجُمُوعَ هُنَاكَ أَيْضًا.
verses.kjv: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
verses.web: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

verses.ar: فَحِينَئِذٍ أَرْسَلَ ٱلْإِخْوَةُ بُولُسَ لِلْوَقْتِ لِيَذْهَبَ كَمَا إِلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ، وَأَمَّا سِيلَا وَتِيمُوثَاوُسُ فَبَقِيَا هُنَاكَ.
verses.kjv: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
verses.web: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ صَاحَبُوا بُولُسَ جَاءُوا بِهِ إِلَى أَثِينَا. وَلَمَّا أَخَذُوا وَصِيَّةً إِلَى سِيلَا وَتِيمُوثَاوُسَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَا إِلَيْهِ بِأَسْرَعِ مَا يُمْكِنُ، مَضَوْا.
verses.kjv: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.web: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

verses.ar: وَبَيْنَمَا بُولُسُ يَنْتَظِرُهُمَا فِي أَثِينَا ٱحْتَدَّتْ رُوحُهُ فِيهِ، إِذْ رَأَى ٱلْمَدِينَةَ مَمْلُؤَةً أَصْنَامًا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
verses.web: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

verses.ar: فَكَانَ يُكَلِّمُ فِي ٱلْمَجْمَعِ ٱلْيَهُودَ ٱلْمُتَعَبِّدِينَ، وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَادِفُونَهُ فِي ٱلسُّوقِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
verses.kjv: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
verses.web: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

verses.ar: فَقَابَلَهُ قَوْمٌ مِنَ ٱلْفَلَاسِفَةِ ٱلْأَبِيكُورِيِّينَ وَٱلرِّوَاقِيِّينَ، وَقَالَ بَعْضٌ: «تُرَى مَاذَا يُرِيدُ هَذَا ٱلْمِهْذَارُ أَنْ يَقُولَ؟». وَبَعْضٌ: «إِنَّهُ يَظْهَرُ مُنَادِيًا بِآلِهَةٍ غَرِيبَةٍ». لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ يُبَشِّرُهُمْ بِيَسُوعَ وَٱلْقِيَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
verses.web: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذُوهُ وَذَهَبُوا بِهِ إِلَى أَرِيُوسَ بَاغُوسَ، قَائِلِينَ: «هَلْ يُمْكِنُنَا أَنْ نَعْرِفَ مَا هُوَ هَذَا ٱلتَّعْلِيمُ ٱلْجَدِيدُ ٱلَّذِي تَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, [is]?
verses.web: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ تَأْتِي إِلَى مَسَامِعِنَا بِأُمُورٍ غَرِيبَةٍ، فَنُرِيدُ أَنْ نَعْلَمَ مَا عَسَى أَنْ تَكُونَ هَذِهِ».
verses.kjv: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
verses.web: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلْأَثِينَوِيُّونَ أَجْمَعُونَ وَٱلْغُرَبَاءُ ٱلْمُسْتَوْطِنُونَ، فَلَا يَتَفَرَّغُونَ لِشَيْءٍ آخَرَ، إِلَّا لِأَنْ يَتَكَلَّمُوا أَوْ يَسْمَعُوا شَيْئًا حَديثًا.
verses.kjv: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
verses.web: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

verses.ar: فَوَقَفَ بُولُسُ فِي وَسْطِ أَرِيُوسَ بَاغُوسَ وَقَالَ: «أَيُّهَا ٱلرِّجَالُ ٱلْأَثِينِوِيُّونَ! أَرَاكُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ وَجْهٍ كَأَنَّكُمْ مُتَدَيِّنُونَ كَثِيرًا،
verses.kjv: ¶ Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, [Ye] men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
verses.web: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّنِي بَيْنَمَا كُنْتُ أَجْتَازُ وَأَنْظُرُ إِلَى مَعْبُودَاتِكُمْ، وَجَدْتُ أَيْضًا مَذْبَحًا مَكْتُوبًا عَلَيْهِ: «لِإِلَهٍ مَجْهُولٍ». فَٱلَّذِي تَتَّقُونَهُ وَأَنْتُمْ تَجْهَلُونَهُ، هَذَا أَنَا أُنَادِي لَكُمْ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
verses.web: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

verses.ar: ٱلْإِلَهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلْعَالَمَ وَكُلَّ مَا فِيهِ، هَذَا، إِذْ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ، لَا يَسْكُنُ فِي هَيَاكِلَ مَصْنُوعَةٍ بِٱلْأَيَادِي،
verses.kjv: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
verses.web: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

verses.ar: وَلَا يُخْدَمُ بِأَيَادِي ٱلنَّاسِ كَأَنَّهُ مُحْتَاجٌ إِلَى شَيْءٍ، إِذْ هُوَ يُعْطِي ٱلْجَمِيعَ حَيَاةً وَنَفْسًا وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ.
verses.kjv: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
verses.web: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

verses.ar: وَصَنَعَ مِنْ دَمٍ وَاحِدٍ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْكُنُونَ عَلَى كُلِّ وَجْهِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَحَتَمَ بِٱلْأَوْقَاتِ ٱلْمُعَيَّنَةِ وَبِحُدُودِ مَسْكَنِهِمْ،
verses.kjv: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
verses.web: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَطْلُبُوا ٱللهَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَلَمَّسُونَهُ فَيَجِدُوهُ، مَعَ أَنَّهُ عَنْ كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَّا لَيْسَ بَعِيدًا.
verses.kjv: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
verses.web: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّنَا بِهِ نَحْيَا وَنَتَحَرَّكُ وَنُوجَدُ، كَمَا قَالَ بَعْضُ شُعَرَائِكُمْ أَيْضًا: لِأَنَّنَا أَيْضًا ذُرِّيَّتُهُ.
verses.kjv: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.web: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

verses.ar: فَإِذْ نَحْنُ ذُرِّيَّةُ ٱللهِ، لَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ نَظُنَّ أَنَّ ٱللَّاهُوتَ شَبِيهٌ بِذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ أَوْ حَجَرِ نَقْشِ صِنَاعَةِ وَٱخْتِرَاعِ إِنْسَانٍ.
verses.kjv: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.
verses.web: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

verses.ar: فَٱللهُ ٱلْآنَ يَأْمُرُ جَمِيعَ ٱلنَّاسِ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ أَنْ يَتُوبُوا، مُتَغَاضِيًا عَنْ أَزْمِنَةِ ٱلْجَهْلِ.
verses.kjv: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verses.web: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ أَقَامَ يَوْمًا هُوَ فِيهِ مُزْمِعٌ أَنْ يَدِينَ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةَ بِٱلْعَدْلِ، بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ عَيَّنَهُ، مُقَدِّمًا لِلْجَمِيعِ إِيمَانًا إِذْ أَقَامَهُ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ».
verses.kjv: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by [that] man whom he hath ordained; [whereof] he hath given assurance unto all [men], in that he hath raised him from the dead.
verses.web: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا بِٱلْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ كَانَ ٱلْبَعْضُ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ، وَٱلْبَعْضُ يَقُولُونَ: «سَنَسْمَعُ مِنْكَ عَنْ هَذَا أَيْضًا!».
verses.kjv: ¶ And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this [matter].
verses.web: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

verses.ar: وَهَكَذَا خَرَجَ بُولُسُ مِنْ وَسْطِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: So Paul departed from among them.
verses.web: Thus Paul went out from among them.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنَّ أُنَاسًا ٱلْتَصَقُوا بِهِ وَآمَنُوا، مِنْهُمْ دِيُونِيسِيُوسُ ٱلْأَرِيُوبَاغِيُّ، وَٱمْرَأَةٌ ٱسْمُهَا دَامَرِسُ وَآخَرُونَ مَعَهُمَا.
verses.kjv: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which [was] Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.web: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
